description: This file defines the ShuffleReadMetrics class and related classes for collecting and reporting shuffle read metrics in Apache Spark. It includes accumulators for various metrics, methods to access and modify these metrics, and a temporary metrics holder class.

classes.name: ShuffleReadMetrics
classes.description: A collection of accumulators that represent metrics about reading shuffle data. Provides methods to access and modify shuffle read metrics.

classes.name: TempShuffleReadMetrics
classes.description: A temporary holder for shuffle read metrics used to collect metrics per shuffle dependency before merging into ShuffleReadMetrics.

methods.name: remoteBlocksFetched
methods.description: Returns the total number of remote blocks fetched in this shuffle.

methods.name: localBlocksFetched
methods.description: Returns the total number of local blocks fetched in this shuffle.

methods.name: remoteBytesRead
methods.description: Returns the total number of remote bytes read from the shuffle.

methods.name: remoteBytesReadToDisk
methods.description: Returns the total number of remote bytes read to disk.

methods.name: localBytesRead
methods.description: Returns the total number of local bytes read.

methods.name: fetchWaitTime
methods.description: Returns the total time spent waiting for remote shuffle blocks.

methods.name: recordsRead
methods.description: Returns the total number of records read from the shuffle.

methods.name: totalBytesRead
methods.description: Returns the sum of remote and local bytes read.

methods.name: totalBlocksFetched
methods.description: Returns the sum of remote and local blocks fetched.

methods.name: corruptMergedBlockChunks
methods.description: Returns the number of corrupt merged shuffle block chunks encountered.

methods.name: mergedFetchFallbackCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times fallback to original shuffle blocks was needed.

methods.name: remoteMergedBlocksFetched
methods.description: Returns the number of remote merged blocks fetched.

methods.name: localMergedBlocksFetched
methods.description: Returns the number of local merged blocks fetched.

methods.name: remoteMergedChunksFetched
methods.description: Returns the number of remote merged chunks fetched.

methods.name: localMergedChunksFetched
methods.description: Returns the number of local merged chunks fetched.

methods.name: remoteMergedBytesRead
methods.description: Returns the total remote merged bytes read.

methods.name: localMergedBytesRead
methods.description: Returns the total local merged bytes read.

methods.name: remoteReqsDuration
methods.description: Returns the total duration of remote requests.

methods.name: remoteMergedReqsDuration
methods.description: Returns the total duration of remote merged requests.
